verdict.comment: Recent winner Dawn Of Liberation had endured a long losing sequence and EEETEE (nap) is selected to end his.

comments.dawnofliberation: Five-runner Beverley race (1m2f, good) 11 days ago was first win since 2022; back up 4lb
comments.eeetee: His latest win was in May 2023 but it's easy to make a case given his falling mark
comments.ghoststory: Five races; C&D novice win last July on second outing; heavy defeat latest; off 203 days
comments.islandofskye: Won stable debut at Thirsk (1m) last June; backward steps in his three starts since
comments.lafleurpetrus: Free-going sort; no serious impact this year in her three starts for new yard, 1m2f latest
comments.landingboard: One run for Jane Chapple-Hyam, two for this yard; lacks solid claims for handicap debut
comments.milteye: Placed in 1m handicaps this year on both starts back in Britain but stamina to prove
comments.mollyvalentine: Three wins on AW; opposable on all turf form except for a soft-ground win in 2023
comments.romansecret: Best turf results have been in the mud; left Richard Fahey for 7,000gns in October
comments.thehun: Second in four of eight starts for Karl Burke; beaten a long way on all three for new yard
comments.universalstory: 11-2 from 8-1 for handicap/turf debut at Yarmouth (1m2f) in April but faded into 6th of 8

races.raceComment: beachpoint is marginally preferred with a score of 52.2%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and superior course form over mollyvalentine. verdict.comment: A competetive handicap in which POET'S DAWN is taken to capitalise on a career-low mark at the expense of Code Purple.

comments.alfieboy: Made all to win twice this season but raced too freely at Beverley; bounce back needed
comments.astronomica: Both wins at 1m on soft in 2023; runner-up twice last year; will appreciate any rain
comments.carnivalzain: Without a win since 2022; fourth on his reappearance but failed to build on that last time
comments.cattonlady: 1-14; well beaten on reappearance but might have needed it and now on career-low mark
comments.codepurple: Last 2 wins at Musselburgh and returned to form back there last time; drawn wide
comments.eyupitsjazz: All three wins have been on soft/heavy ground; trip is an unknown on return from break
comments.jezbomb: Won at Thirsk in April and posted a solid effort following an awkward start here last time
comments.keadytown: Beaten 32l on yard debut last year and he's shown little in two starts over hurdles
comments.mrjetman: Gained his first win in nearly two years over C&D 17 days ago; back up 5lb
comments.northbound: Won twice on AW this year; 1-22 on turf but he has a place chance on second start for yard
comments.overlooked: 0-15 but has shaped encouragingly a few times since joining this yard; steps back up to 1m
comments.poetsdawn: Veteran who has been in good form; second of 11 at Redcar last time; on a career-low mark
comments.saisonsdor: Back up 2lb for his Southwell AW win 34 days ago; steps back up to 1m and returns to turf
comments.shamardalstar: 0-8 (bumper/Flat) for Adrian Keatley; switches back to turf on stable debut
comments.withoutcompromise: 0-9; third on Southwell AW in March; drops back to 1m on turf debut after a wind operation

races.raceComment: mrjetman is marginally preferred with a score of 53.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over poetsdawn. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 2 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Paul Midgley's two runners are handicapped to go well but so is JOJO RABBIT and Ruth Carr's 7yo can get the better of younger rivals.

comments.caesarspearl: Just one win from 20 starts; not at best on AW earlier in the year; opposable back at 5f
comments.chiefofstate: Potential improver now handicapping at a realistic level in new accessories
comments.darkkestrel: Slow starts an issue; dangerous mark if his latest wind surgery has the desired effect
comments.herakles: Won this race off 9lb higher last year; yet to shine in 2025 but can't discount a revival
comments.jojorabbit: Two wins off much higher marks last year; type to pop up soon & he's run well here before
comments.rockofengland: 0-13 for P Midgley but tumbled down the weights; yard's record in this race is notable
comments.runningcool: Struggled since joining this yard but tumbled down the weights; check betting back at 5f
comments.wrestlingrevenue: Two Brighton wins for T Carroll last year; yet to match that in four runs for new trainer
comments.zaphea: Two heavy defeats in Class 4 so far this year; only of interest if attracting support

races.raceComment: herakles is marginally preferred with a score of 49.5%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over jojorabbit. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts.
